label.help: Send your task as a regular message — Codex will run it in the selected directory. You can send voice messages, audio files, documents, and photos. Chats and projects /new — choose a directory and start a new chat /chats — choose a saved chat /rename name — rename the chat /fork — create a copy of the current chat /delete — delete the current chat and its copies /compact — compact the chat context /recap — get a brief summary without compacting the context /init — create AGENTS.md for the project if it does not exist /files — browse, open, and download project files Settings /model — choose a Codex model using a button /fast — toggle fast mode, if available /mode — choose answers, quiet updates, or a detailed log /plan — switch between Plan and Default; /plan task — start planning a task /goal objective — work until the goal is achieved; /goal — show status; /goal edit — edit the goal; /goal pause/resume/clear — manage the goal /permissions — choose the permission mode for the chat /skills — choose or configure Codex skills /memories — configure the use and creation of Codex local memory /mcp — view and configure Codex MCP servers; /mcp verbose — detailed list /language — choose the interface language Task control /stop — stop a Codex task or the current shell command /ps — background terminals for the current chat /shell — open an interactive shell in the TeleCodex environment; /shell command — run a single command /exit — close the interactive shell and return to Codex Diagnostics and recovery /status — chat and limit status /doctor — check the connection to Telegram and Codex /recover — restart Codex for the current chat while preserving its history Groups /group_add — connect a group /group_remove — disconnect a group or cancel its setup /group_mode — switch the group to sending all regular messages to Codex
